The selection was so diverse, it took a few days to choose. Regarding appliances, I chose the Geogeoikseon, a 14-person machine with a hot air dryer. After measuring the size of the kitchen cabinet and mop holder, I chose the right one. The technician came two days after ordering. He was incredibly friendly, from the installation process to the explanations. I should have bought detergent and salt in advance, but I didn't. Today, for the first time, I felt liberated from washing dishes. Even though I only used the 1-hour cycle without the hot air drying, the dishes still had a warm, fresh scent. It seems to be sterilizing well. There were almost no traces of water, so I think they'll be naturally dried by the next morning. I plan to use the hot air drying about once a week. I used the Ecover Zero detergent tablet. After searching, I saw a tip that said it would clean well even if you put it on the bottom instead of in the tablet holder. I followed the standard procedure and put it in the tablet holder. Once I get used to it, I plan to try putting it on the bottom as well. #LGDishwasher #Grade1 #DUE6BGL1E

Sentence (English): Advantages.
Comments (English): [ #Easy to use #Recommended for value #Dishwasher #Recommended for newlyweds ] || ---------------- || Advantages. Cleaning Power. With a 6-place capacity, it cleans not only standard dishes, cups, and cutlery but also greasy frying pans and soup bowls thoroughly using detergent and hot water. It is hygienic and satisfying as almost no water stains or marks remain after washing. Ease of Use. The touch panel located on the top is very simple to operate, making it easy for anyone to use. Another advantage is that the noise level during operation is lower than normal conversation, allowing for comfortable use even at night. Additionally, the included dish drying function effectively removes moisture after washing, making it convenient to take out and use immediately. Washing Time. It takes approximately 1 hour and 40 minutes in standard mode. Washing times may vary depending on the mode, so selecting the appropriate option allows for efficient use. Design. The use of white glass material transforms the kitchen into a more sophisticated and clean atmosphere. Thanks to BESPOKE's signature minimalist and modern exterior, it blends well with kitchen interiors. Power and Water Consumption. The rated power consumption is approximately 1,200W, and water usage per wash is about 10L, allowing you to save both water and electricity compared to hand washing. It is satisfactory in terms of environmental friendliness and cost-effectiveness. Cons and Precautions: Large pots or woks do not fit inside, often requiring separate hand washing. Due to the low interior height, large plates must be inserted at an angle, which may slightly reduce cleaning efficiency. Overall just a top end unit with exceptional cleaning, superior drying and very quiet. Its great to have actually dry dishes and even plastics coming out of the washer and I would recommend this over a Bosch 500 or 800 if you are looking at them both.

Overall, I am extremely dissatisfied with the whole experience and am soured on the machine and brand.

Sentence (English): Let's start with the positives.
Comments (English): [ A big disappointment ] || ---------------- || Let's start with the positives. The dishwasher is quiet. You can run it at any time and it will not interfere with something else going on in the house. Secondly, it looks good. Another big plus.Now, for the negatives. The first is that is shipped with an inferior drain hose. The hose is brittle and you can anticipate a catastrophic failure in a year or so. I did not use what shipped. I installed it with a drain hose made of much better material.Next, the design has at least one fatal flaw. That is, the door does not pop open at the end of the drying cycle. That means the dishes are never dry. I also consider it a flaw that you have to select the "Drying Boost" option for it to dry at all. Otherwise, it default to air drying. Again, the door doesn't pop open so everything is totally wet when you air dry.Most importantly, it does not work well. If you load up the utensil rack, you are left with many unwashed utensils. In addition to the utensils not washing well, you will always find a few unwashed dishes. I inspect everything as I am "drying" the dishes and putting them away.In my house, we take turns washing the dishes. My wife dislikes the dishwasher so much that when it is her turn, she washes by hand.

After spending too long diagnosing the leak coming from the rear of the tub I tried to work with Bosch to address the issue as there was no part for the fix. They wanted $200 for the service call and then $25 per every 6 minutes to review the fault. I offered video evidence of the leak and location which they said would not cut it. While tub issues are "covered" under the warranty the call center rep explained that it would likely not be covered unless I could see rust coming through from the inside of the tub, there was no known fix and any tech fees would not be refunded either way. Despite this being a known defect in the 500 and 800 units for years (check Reddit - there are forums on it) Bosch refused to stand by the product. When I asked for something, anything to make me buy another Bosch in it's place they refused again. Overall, customer service was pretty terrible. Thankfully the people at Lowes were very helpful and I've acquired a KitchenAid instead and it has been much more quiet, cleans better and objects are much drier than I ever imagined the Bosch being capable of. The Bosch went to a recycling center with an otherwise perfect mechanical and electrical system because it couldn't keep water where it needed to be, a prerequisite for acceptable dish washers. Buyer beware.

So there's another product we have to buy regularly now in order to (hopefully) get this dishwasher to begin doing it's job and not smell like a dirty old shoe every time you open it. Also, note that all of the other positive customer reviews received this dishwasher as part of a promotion? Comments (English): [ Bad Experience with the Installation! ] || ---------------- || To start with, I'd like to mention that I have been a Costco customer for decades and have been happy with the product and services I have received. This good history might be the reason I am very disappointed with this occasion. When I was investigating to figure out what should I buy, I looked at the reviews and I found out people are, in general, happy about the product, though some people were unhappy about the "installation service", so I read those reviews even more carefully. Those reviews, in particular, suggested that a GFCI power outlet is needed prior to installation. So, I spent a number of hours of my time to upgrade the regular power outlet to a GFCI outlet. I also should mention that the cost of this dishwasher is more expensive than some other stores, however, since the "Installation" and "parts" where part of the package, I chose Costco's more expensive offer, since I thought this would be an easier option with piece of mind and "no hidden fees"! The installers, however, asked for additional features such as AFCI outlet as well as a Water Pressure Regulator on the water line. They asked me for an additional $340 (on top of already $100+ I spent on GFCI work). Comments (English): [ Finally, welcoming Auntie! ] || ---------------- || I am a reviewer who is a working mom for whom life is absolutely, absolutely impossible without Coupang, a housewife of 9 years, and a member of a family of three : ). Although my writing is personal, I am writing this review reflecting my opinions to be helpful. As a working mom, after getting off work and taking my child home alone, I find the cutlery set, cups, and water bottle brought home from kindergarten, along with the dishes and water cups from the morning meal, all spread out. Consequently, when I try to do the dishes before washing up, I find I have much more time than I thought, and my child, who just came home from the night, asks to play. Since I am spending so much time on washing dishes, I see myself always saying, "Just a moment, let me tidy up here first... then I'll do it." My body is tired from working, but I know spending time with Mom is important to my child too. I realized I needed to at least shorten the time spent on washing dishes and organizing the kitchen. So, I made a big decision! After looking around, I ordered a 12-place setting dishwasher from Coupang, but when they visited before installation, I received the shocking news that it would be difficult to install one due to the location and structure of my house. But giving up is only fitting for a cabbage, right? Undeterred, I carefully looked at the Samsung Bespoke 6-place setting dishwasher, which is ranked #1 on Coupang. After reading the reviews, I realized that everyone who, like me, found installation impossible had actually bought it. So I bought it right away. Well, what does it matter if it doesn't sit underneath? We are a family of three, and aside from weekends, we don't have that many dishes to wash on weekdays anyway. So, I cleared my mind and went for it! After making the payment, a technician came and installed it beautifully. I was surprised by how big it was—wow!—but since it overlapped with the water purifier, I called a company to move the purifier to a location where my child can drink water easily. Now, the Samsung Bespoke sits perfectly in its place in the dishwashing zone. Seriously, if you are a working mom with a family of 3-4, I think the 6-place setting is just right! Before, I bought a lot of dishes indiscriminately because I didn't have a dishwasher, but now, even when buying... I found myself checking to see if the dishes were dishwasher compatible. People are so fickle. Now, it has truly become an indispensable part of my life. After picking up my child from school and getting off work, I am able to spend a little more time with them. It isn't very noisy, so I even ran it at 10 PM and it was fine. Why did I wait so long to buy this dishwasher? You can just roughly pre-wash the dishes and it takes care of the drying process; the door opens automatically just a little bit. Sentence (English): This is what happens when you don't read and inspect every written piece of information and documentation on something that you think will be like the old one but has changed in ways you do not anticipate.
Comments (English): [ Not what I expected ] || ---------------- || This is what happens when you don't read and inspect every written piece of information and documentation on something that you think will be like the old one but has changed in ways you do not anticipate. Our old Bosch dishwasher stopped working and required maintence, but instead of a costly repair we decided upon a new machine. (Should of had the old machine repaired! ) I didn't read all the literature on the new one and assumed it was like the old one and that it just looked a little different from the picture on the website so we ordered it and never really saw it like "hands on". After delivery and installation I went to do a load of dishes but when I went to use the "delay time" feature I realized it wasn't there and rushed to the instruction manual. I must put an "APP" on my phone to program the delay! What is this? I need to use my cell phone to use my dishwasher! It took an hour to get the app on my cell phone (older model) and I haven't a clue what I need to do now, even though a very patient and knowledgeable gentleman talked me through it all. I'm a senior citizen, we don't have our cell phones glued to our bodies like the younger generation. It's there for emergencies and some texting. Never did I think I would ever need to use my phone to operate my dishwasher! In hindsight knowing what I know now I would have purchased a different make that had all the features I needed and that they worked "ON" the control panel. Other observations, the machine has a nice clean front, a good handle and presents a sophisticated appearance. Inside, the control panel along the top of the door is small and hard to see. Little white lights shine through the features selected and, in my pinion, this whole control panel is not overly sophisticated and does not compliment the machine. The red light shining on the floor when it is in operation is absurd! Who looks at the floor when the machine is working? Wouldn't a small light on the upper corner be more beneficial? When I look at a machine I generally look at the face of it not the base of it. Dishes wash clean and the inside of the dishwasher is clean and efficient. The detergent and wash aid holders/dispensers are the same. The racks are similiar in appearance to the old dishwasher but feel a little flimsier. If I had known this I would have kept the old dishwasher racks. We purchased a Bosch because of it's proven reliability and good value for the money. However, by going forward with technology I believe Bosch has forgotten that there is still a need to operate a machine with ease and without complication.

Without it, the dishes are mostly dry, the plastic still a little wet and the inside of the dishwasher wet. Have been experimenting with when after the end of cycle to open the door for maximum drying and no extra energy use - I have tried immediately and in the morning and 45min after the cycle ends. Sentence (English): This is my first dishwasher, and the experience has been excellent.
Comments (English): [ Excellent ] || ---------------- || This is my first dishwasher, and the experience has been excellent. It cleans perfectly, even dishes that have been dirty for several days. The cutlery is also spotless. I was skeptical at first, as it doesn't have a separate water jet for cutlery in its tray, but instead uses the water jet from the top rack. I thought that if this tray was too full it could affect the cleaning, but that wasn't the case: even residues like yogurt are removed without a problem. Drying is excellent, as long as the dishes are properly placed. It also has an extra drying option for plastics, which I have enabled by default. In my case, the Finish powder detergent gave better results than the Finish Ultimate tablets. I have the rinse aid and salt separately, as I'd say they give better results than the all-in-one tablets. Installation and configuration are simple. However, for the first few days it does give off a plastic smell, so I left it open to air it out. I tried the Finish dishwasher cleaner and didn't like the chemical smell it left behind. As an area for improvement, the cutlery tray doesn't slide completely smoothly when opening and closing; the rails could be of better quality. I also wish the door could open when finished. I've attached before-and-after photos; they're with the tablets I used before, which failed to clean one dish. Powder detergent would be even better.
Comments (Original): [ Excelente ] || ---------------- || Es mi primer lavavajillas y la experiencia ha sido excelente. Limpia a la perfección, incluso platos con suciedad de varios días.Los cubiertos también quedan impecables. Al principio tenía mis dudas, ya que no cuenta con un chorro de agua independiente para ellos en su bandeja, sino que utiliza el de la bandeja superior. Pensé que si esta bandeja estaba muy llena podría afectar la limpieza, pero no ha sido así: incluso restos como yogur se eliminan sin problema.El secado es excelente, siempre que los platos estén bien colocados en su sitio. Además cuenta con la opción extra secado para los plásticos, que he dejado activada por defecto.En mi caso, el detergente en polvo Finish ha dado mejores resultados que las pastillas Finish Ultimate. Tengo el abrillantador y la sal por separado, ya que diría que dan mejor resultado que las pastillas todo en uno.La instalación y configuración son sencillas. Eso sí, durante los primeros días desprende un olor a plástico, por lo que lo dejé abierto para ventilarlo. Probé el limpiamáquinas Finish y no me gustó el olor químico que dejó.Como punto a mejorar, la bandeja de cubiertos no se desliza con total suavidad al abrir y cerrar; los rieles podrían ser de mejor calidad. También hubiera echado de menos que se abra la puerta al acabar.Adjunto fotos del antes y después, son con las pastillas que usaba antes, que me falló en la limpieza de un plato, con el detergente en polvo sería aún mejor.

Comments (English): [ Torn ] || ---------------- || I'm torn here. I replaced a leaking 8 year old Bosch with thr new 800. There are many things I actually prefer about the old one over the "latest and greatest." First, the depth of the bottom rack in 2 inches less. This doesn't sound like much but it makes all the difference when including big pots or pans. I can't load the same pots and plates that I could with the old one. Not good. Second, the old rinse feature is gone. That's a miss. I don't need Bosch telling me how to be efficient and I used that quick rinse feature often in the past. Third, the actual tines in the rack are every so slightly closer together. Again making it harder to load as easily and efficiently. I how have to "skip a space" with different sized plates where I didn't in the past. Lastly, it just doesn't seem as sturdy but time will tell. Now to the good, it cleans as well or better than the old one, especially with tough baked on food. I have felt stuff that I normally wouldn't as a test and it comes clean. The drying is also slightly improved especially on plastic. I returned the 500 series for this one due to the drying. Definitely an improvement but with all of the other challenges not sure it was worth that extra money.

Now to the good, it cleans as well or better than the old one, especially with tough baked on food. I have felt stuff that I normally wouldn't as a test and it comes clean. Definitely an improvement but with all of the other challenges not sure it was worth that extra money.

Sentence (English): This is my first dishwasher, and the experience has been excellent.
Comments (English): [ Excellent ] || ---------------- || This is my first dishwasher, and the experience has been excellent. It cleans perfectly, even dishes that are several days old. The cutlery comes out spotless too. At first, I had my doubts, as it doesn't have a separate water jet for cutlery in its tray; instead, it uses the one from the upper rack. I thought that if this tray was very full, it might affect the cleaning, but that hasn't been the case: even residue like yogurt comes off without a problem. The drying is excellent, as long as the dishes are properly placed. It also has an extra drying option for plastics, which I've left on by default. In my case, Finish powder detergent has given better results than Finish Ultimate tablets. I keep the rinse aid and salt separate, as I'd say they work better than the all-in-one tablets. Installation and setup are simple. However, for the first few days, it gives off a plastic smell, so I left it open to air it out. I tried Finish dishwasher cleaner, and I didn't like the chemical smell it left behind. One area for improvement is that the cutlery tray doesn't slide completely smoothly when opening and closing; the rails could be of better quality. I also wish the door opened automatically when finished. I've attached before and after photos.
Comments (Original): [ Excelente ] || ---------------- || Es mi primer lavavajillas y la experiencia ha sido excelente. Limpia a la perfección, incluso platos con suciedad de varios días.Los cubiertos también quedan impecables. Al principio tenía mis dudas, ya que no cuenta con un chorro de agua independiente para ellos en su bandeja, sino que utiliza el de la bandeja superior. Pensé que si esta bandeja estaba muy llena podría afectar la limpieza, pero no ha sido así: incluso restos como yogur se eliminan sin problema.El secado es excelente, siempre que los platos estén bien colocados en su sitio. Además cuenta con la opción extra secado para los plásticos, que he dejado activada por defecto.En mi caso, el detergente en polvo Finish ha dado mejores resultados que las pastillas Finish Ultimate. Tengo el abrillantador y la sal por separado, ya que diría que dan mejor resultado que las pastillas todo en uno.La instalación y configuración son sencillas. Eso sí, durante los primeros días desprende un olor a plástico, por lo que lo dejé abierto para ventilarlo. Probé el limpiamáquinas Finish y no me gustó el olor químico que dejó.Como punto a mejorar, la bandeja de cubiertos no se desliza con total suavidad al abrir y cerrar; los rieles podrían ser de mejor calidad. También hubiera echado de menos que se abra la puerta al acabar.Adjunto fotos del antes y después.

The cutlery comes out spotless too. At first, I had my doubts, as it doesn't have a separate water jet for cutlery in its tray; instead, it uses the one from the upper rack. Sentence (English): If there is a problem with an order, Lowe's first impulse is to blame the customer.
Comments (English): [ Buyer beware ] || ---------------- || If there is a problem with an order, Lowe's first impulse is to blame the customer.I recently bought a Bosch dishwasher that shipped from Lowe's Olive Branch location. My plumber came to install the dishwasher yesterday, only to find that the power cord that was supposed to be supplied with the dishwasher was not included. I called Lowe's customer service, which told me - incorrectly - that the power cord is not included with the dishwasher. I pointed out that Lowe's web site and the Bosch product manual state that the power cord is included. The call center rep contacted the Olive Branch store and connected me with a salesperson there. Like the call center rep, the Olive Branch salesperson argued with me about the missing part. She was dismissive and rude. She insisted that the power cord is not included with the dishwasher that I bought. When I told her that Lowe's own web site says that the power cord is included, she hung up on me.I am now waiting on an overdue call back from Lowe's customer service. Based on my experience thus far, I have every confidence that Lowe's customer service will continue to disappoint. If I can ever obtain the missing power cord, I will still have to pay my plumber for a second trip to my house.A screen shot from the Lowe's web site is included with this review.

Sentence (English): I didn't know anything about installation and how to use it.
Comments (English): I didn't know anything about installation and how to use it. I hesitated for a year, but then I went to the store to check it out and was about to buy the latest model. Then I saw a live broadcast and got notified, so I bought it. My sink is 800cm, so I wanted to add a 200cm sink shelf and a seasoning rail. It took some time to find out about it after purchasing the dishwasher, so I had it installed. You'll need to have the rail installed separately by a sink installer or interior designer. The dishwasher installation schedule was always updated, so they contacted me in advance, which was very convenient. They even visited me in advance to confirm installation availability and offered tips on the most cost-effective method. If you're far from an electrical outlet, be sure to get a high-capacity power strip. We have one right next door, but it's connected to a city gas outlet, so I didn't want to share it, so I grabbed a power strip from the wall outlet in the next room. The installer did a great job of installing it neatly and organizing the cord. He was very kind, explaining the installation process and coordinating the schedule with me. LG is the best when it comes to appliances. I haven't used it yet, but I'm thinking it'll be similar to a washing machine. My heart is pounding~ I can just turn it back on in the evening and wake up now, right? I'm so happy~~^^

Especially if you live alone or have one or two people, just a few dishes a day can be a hassle. So, I kept looking at dishwasher reviews on Carrot, but I never bought one. Seriously, I've been wanting to try 5 or 6 Mixx products, but this one came up on the Coupang Experience Group! I immediately picked it up! Media is a brand known for its surprisingly good value. It even has a UV sterilization function, so I was excited for its hygienic use. Honest Review: [My Water Filling Tip!] This was surprisingly easy. I didn't have to worry about connecting any complicated hoses. I just removed the hose from the faucet on the drip tray and poured water into it. I keep it right next to the sink, and since I rinse the dishes and put them in the dishwasher right away, the stress of washing dishes has been greatly reduced. [Satisfaction with cleaning power] Honestly, I was a little worried about the cleaning power, but wow. I was surprised that even the oily dishes, soup bowls, and chopsticks came out sparkling clean. I intentionally put it in without pre-washing it as a test, and it cleaned the chili oil soup bowl well. (I took before and after pictures!) In particular, thanks to the UV sterilization function, it is fluffy and odorless when I take it out, so I feel safe about hygiene. [Small but spacious interior] I thought it would be small because it says it is for 3 people, but it holds more than I thought, including dishes, cups, and spoons. At first, I didn't know how to use it, so I read a lot of blogs. They say that if you get good at Tetris while using it, you can wash more dishes efficiently! (I'm still a beginner. I thought it would be small because it's for three people, but it holds more than enough dishes, cups, and spoons. I wasn't sure how to use it at first, so I read a lot of blog posts. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a compact dishwasher that takes up little space and has great cleaning power!

I even tested it by skipping the pre-washing process, and it cleaned the chili oil soup bowl perfectly. (I took before and after pictures!) Thanks to the UV sterilization function, it's fluffy and odor-free when I take it out, which is especially reassuring for hygiene. [Small but roomy interior]. I thought it would be small because it's for three people, but it holds more than enough dishes, cups, and spoons. I wasn't sure how to use it at first, so I read a lot of blog posts. They said that if you master the Tetris game, you can wash more dishes more efficiently! (I'm still a beginner, so I'm experimenting a lot.) [Clean design]. The white color and clean design blend well with your kitchen interior. Because it's window-type, you can see the inside being cleaned while in use, which makes you feel good. Rating: (5/5). I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a compact dishwasher that takes up little space and has great cleaning power!

I thought it would be small because it's for three people, but it holds more than enough dishes, cups, and spoons. I wasn't sure how to use it at first, so I read a lot of blog posts. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a compact dishwasher that takes up little space and has great cleaning power!

Sentence (English): Lately, the biggest stress of housework used to be washing dishes, but after finally deciding to bite the bullet and install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting model (DUE6BGL3E), I can definitely feel my quality of life improving.
Comments (English): [ It's nice. ] || ---------------- || Lately, the biggest stress of housework used to be washing dishes, but after finally deciding to bite the bullet and install the LG DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting model (DUE6BGL3E), I can definitely feel my quality of life improving. First, regarding the exterior, the Nature Beige color matches my kitchen interior perfectly. It is a luxurious yet calm shade that blends naturally into any kitchen style. In terms of performance, I am truly satisfied. Since it is a 14-place setting model, the capacity is generous enough to run a full cycle even after two or three meals a day, and thanks to the Tornado washing blades, I can visibly see every nook and cranny getting cleaned. In particular, the 100% True Steam function has excellent sterilization effects, so I feel at ease when washing children's dishes or glass cups. The difference is incomparable to the small dishwasher I used before. It is also almost silent, so running it late at night is not a burden at all, and since it finishes cleanly with residual heat drying after washing, there is no need to wipe or shake off water separately. I feel like my water usage has decreased, so I am quite satisfied in terms of value for money. LG visited in person for a neat installation, and they kindly explained how to use it, so I was able to adapt easily even as a first-time user. Overall, the price is a bit on the higher side, but I think it is well worth the investment considering it allows you to achieve both kitchen efficiency and hygiene. Comments (English): [ Since we use more dishes than air dishes, we have been using American and German products that can hold a lot of dishes for about 30 years, and while looking for a new dishwasher because the product we were using was uncomfortable, we came across this one. ] || ---------------- || Because we use more dishes than plates, we've been using American and German dishwashers for about 30 years, which can accommodate a lot of dishes. Since the ones I used were uncomfortable, I was looking for a new dishwasher, and I bought this one because it was eligible for Naver Card discounts and rebates, and it also seats 14 people. I used to simply enjoy using a dishwasher because it freed me from the burden of washing dishes, but these days, cleaning power is a given, so as I get older, the internal layout of the dishwasher feels important to me. The 14-person capacity was particularly appealing because it seemed like it would be easy to arrange. When arranging dishes, cups, plates, and pans, the arrangements don't always match, so it becomes a battle to arrange them properly. This takes more time, and bending over to adjust the dishwasher to the bottom requires more back strength than when I was younger. This leads to back pain and exhaustion from just loading the dishes. I'm already exhausted before I even press the start button, so even with a dishwasher, washing dishes is a huge chore for me. After using this product for a while, I realized that I can organize the space according to the situation, and since the height can be adjusted, I can put small pots on top, so I definitely spend less time worrying about arranging dishes, and my body discomfort has also decreased. Also, the rack function that folds and unfolds is very convenient even when there are a lot of large plates. The AI function is also convenient, and I just use the AI as the default. There are also various washing methods that I can download to my phone, which is nice. These days, some households install the dishwasher at waist height, so I plan to install it higher in my next house. I applied for the detergent on the day of installation, and it arrived the next day.

Sentence (English): This is a good basic dishwasher that I have been using every few days for 3 months now.
Comments (English): [ Good appliance, some quirks so far ] || ---------------- || This is a good basic dishwasher that I have been using every few days for 3 months now. It is decently quiet and does a good job. I live in a hard water area and the dishes seem to come out nice and clean with the use of the correct products, including a higher quality rinse agent. The rinse agent filler is a little nonintuitive and refilling it can get a bit sloppy. I am subtracting another star because it has had one issue so far, where it refused to start powering a cycle or drawing water in-- it simply said it was "on" and was stuck like that. I reset the breaker and the issue did not return since, but i will keep an eye on this. One thing I do like is the front of it is actually metal, so I can stick my dishwasher status slider magnet to it.

It doesn't have to be dishes with dried-on food residue; just a simple bowl of soup used in a meal 30 minutes before starting the wash cycle is enough. I no longer fill the machine like I used to fill an old 15-year-old Siemens machine, because otherwise I have to wash all the dishes by hand at the end of the cycle. The only positive I see with this machine is the drying performance; they always come out impeccably dry.

Sentence (English): Highly recommend getting this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Love my new dishwasher <3 ] || ---------------- || Highly recommend getting this dishwasher! I had a fairly decent Kitchenaid dishwasher that came with our hour, but it started to not clean as well over time. I spent a bunch of money to repair it, maintain it, and learn everything I could to make it run better, but it always left issues with our dishes. I ended up getting doing a lot of research and considered getting a budget dishwasher but my wife convinced me we should probably splurge a bit for such an important device (we use ours once/twice a day). I can't be more happy that I did. This dishwasher always always cleans and dries our dishes, glasses and cookware perfectly. It's insanely quiet - so much so that the only way to tell its running is the red light. I also love the app - as a new homeowner and someone new to the responsibilities of owning a dishwasher (even though its been 3-4 years), I find the app just helps me understand how to maintain it with pictures/videos for cleaning the filter, reminders to refill rinse aid and telling me when the load is done. Seems silly to need an app for a dishwasher, but my wife is thrilled when I get excited about a notification from the dishwasher and immediately jump out of my seat to take action to maintain it or unload it. I used to also unload our dishwasher, notice stains on our forks and bowls and proceed to ask my wife if she rinsed the dishes, made sure things weren't dried/stuck on, etc. - not anymore. We haven't had a single conversation about if the dishwasher did it's job in over 2 months. Maybe this is me entering middle-age/dad territory, but I absolutely love this thing and it's now one of my favourite things in my house. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this dishwasher to everyone I know.

Sentence (English): I bought and used a Minix dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ I was worried about washing dishes because the sink in the house I moved into was small. ] || ---------------- || I bought and used a Minix dishwasher! It's a bit noisier than I expected, but it's not a major concern! When I first unpacked it, I noticed some moisture, so I thought it was a returned product. But then I saw someone else's review saying it was tested before shipping, and I realized it was! The dishwasher fit perfectly in my small sink, and while the capacity seems quite small for its size, I think it'll work just fine if I play Tetris with it! I'm not sure if it's because I used a detergent other than the one specifically for it or if it's just the way it is, but it does occasionally feel slippery, and water stains don't stay on forever. Sometimes they appear and sometimes they don't, so I think I need to use it a bit more. The difference between when it was there and when it wasn't is a big deal, so I think it was a good purchase. I'm very satisfied and using it well! Next time, I'll try using the specialized detergent! ------------------------------------ It's been about a month since I bought it. Sometimes it washes and wipes well, but lately, it feels like it's not cleaning all the corners. Seasoning stains have come off, but I've started to see more stains on the dishes. I thought maybe I packed the dishes too tightly, so I spread them out so that the water could reach them and ran it, but it still wouldn't come off. I tried the easy wash, strong wash, and clean modes all in one day, but it still wouldn't come off. It's so persistent that I wondered if it was even picking at the dishes to wash them. It seemed to wash well at first, but it's ironic. So these days, I just wash the first few dishes and then put them away. I bought it because I didn't want to do dishes, but I have to do them anyway. Still, I'm using it because I think it's better than nothing.

Sentence (English): I had this dishwasher at a previous home and liked it enough that when my current dishwasher began to fail I replaced it with this same model.
Comments (English): [ Solid, Silent, Efficient, and Effective ] || ---------------- || I had this dishwasher at a previous home and liked it enough that when my current dishwasher began to fail I replaced it with this same model. I'm very happy with the washing performance. I don't pre-rinse and the Normal cycle does a good job with most jobs, with only the occasional dish that needs post-washing. The Normal cycle is the most water efficient (as little as 2.5 gallons), though it typically runs about 2.5 hours. The ProWash cycle produces clean dishes with even the most heavily soiled dishes, and does it in 1.75 hours, but it uses at minimum of 9.75 gallons of water, so I only use it for especially large or heavily soiled loads. I don't use heated dry most of the time, but the few times I've used it I was overall pleased with the outcome, though as others have noted it leaves some plastic items in the top racks a little wet. It's got a quality, substantial feel to the components. I like that it has a built-in leak sensor that will stop the cycle and drain the water if a leak at the door seal or inlet connection occurs. The second rack easily adjusts to one of two heights with the push of a couple of butttons, and it slides in and out smoothly, unlike most dishwasher 2nd racks. The third rack accommodates enough silverware that I actually leave the dedicated silverware tray out altogether, leaving more space in the bottom rack for large items. And its very quiet overall. It's worth noting that the sound rating of 39 dB is an average of the noise level over the whole cycle. There are some points at which you'll hear it, but it's effectively silent from 3 or more feet away for most of the cycle. Also, I've noticed it's quieter with a more full load.In terms of things to improve, on this latest unit I've noticed that when the 2nd rack is loaded and extended, when I go to push it back in, the wheels will sometimes squeak. I was advised by the installer to contact KitchenAid about a suitable lubricant. I haven't gotten around to that yet. Other than that, one minor complaint I have is that the touch panel is really, really sensitive. It's very easy to accidentally press a button just reaching across the counter or when unloading the dishes. It would be nice if there was another row of tines in the bottom rack, fold-down tines in the bottom and 2nd rack, or a cup shelf in the 2nd rack. Overall, I would definitely recommend this dishwasher. After all, I liked it enough to buy it a second time.

Sentence (English): If you're the kind of person who wants your appliances to just work without making a fuss, the Bosch 800 Series SHV78CM3N might be exactly what you're looking for.
Comments (English): [ By far the best dishwasher we ever had ] || ---------------- || If you're the kind of person who wants your appliances to just work without making a fuss, the Bosch 800 Series SHV78CM3N might be exactly what you're looking for. It's super quiet—like, 42 dBA quiet—so you can actually hear yourself think (or chat over dinner) while it's running. And even with a full load—up to sixteen place settings—everything still comes out sparkling. The PrecisionWash sensors are constantly adjusting the spray pattern based on what's inside, so it doesn't waste a drop. One of my favorite things? It completely disappears behind custom cabinetry. So if you're going for that clean, built-in look in the kitchen, it blends right in. What really makes it easy to love, though, are the everyday touches. The racks glide smoothly (even when full), and that third rack up top is a game changer for silverware and little odds and ends—no more cramming everything into the utensil basket. The floor-level InfoLight is subtle but helpful, especially since you can barely hear the thing when it's on. And with the Home Connect app, you can check if the cycle's done—or reorder detergent—from your phone. Super convenient. Now, about the drying—Bosch's CrystalDry with PowerControl isn't just a buzzword. It actually works. Even plastic containers come out totally dry, which is not something I could say about my last dishwasher. Add in the adjustable racks and sturdy build, and it feels like something that's going to last for years without much thought. It's not flashy, but it is solid, sleek, and really thoughtfully designed. Honestly, you install it once and then kinda forget about it. which is probably the best compliment a dishwasher can get.

Sentence (English): A couple of items.
Comments (English): [ A few important details ] || ---------------- || A couple of items. First, The water inlet male connector is made of plastic while the hose fitting is brass. The instructions say tighten by hand but that is not enough and you will get a leak. Eventually, I had to use teflon tape and a light turn of a wrench. Two, the starting process is not intuitive. You have to enter all of the details while door is open. Then you have a few seconds after mode entry to close the door. There are no more lights on the top read out once it starts. So somebody else would'nt be able to tell what mode you're in. Then, there is no readout on the top that it is on and the amount of time left. Instead, there is a red light that shines on the floor. Comments (English): [ Quiet Dishwasher that looks Nice ] || ---------------- || My 19-year-old Whirlpool dishwasher finally bit the dust and right when I had company coming for the weekend. Best Buy was able to find me this dishwasher that was actually in stock and able to be delivered in a few days. It was on sale, and I saved about $400 so that was a bonus. My previous dishwasher was black, and I wanted another black one but none were available in the time frame I needed it in, so I settled with this one and it actually looks good in place of the black (all my appliances are black). To be completely honest, I don't love it as much as I did the one I had before, guess I'm still getting used to it. I had a silverware rack in the door which saved space, and this one has the removable tray which does take away space for bigger items. It has the extra row up top for larger utensils and not sure if I like it or not as it takes space from the upper row, but it is removable, so bonus. I do like that it is quiet and seems to get everything clean. It has more options for cleaning than my older one did and that is another bonus. The one hour clean doesn't get the dishes dry enough, I have to add the feature for the dry boost which makes it take longer, but I'm ok with that. Doesn't seem to have as much space for loading as my other but I'm learning a different set up so that will take time, I'm sure. Overall, I like it, don't love it but I'm getting used to it. Change is harder as we get older, lol. It does the job and is quiet and looks good.

Sentence (English): I purchased this Bosch 100 series Dishwasher to replace another brand.
Comments (English): [ Loud & App-Dependent: Bosch 100 Series Disappoints ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch 100 series Dishwasher to replace another brand. I decided on Bosch because my parents' dishwasher has worked flawlessly for the last 15 years, while I've gone through 3 dishwashers from other brands. The one they have is also so quiet you can literally sit next to it and have no idea it's running. As I needed a new one I figured it was the perfect time to jump into quality German craftsmanship my parents have been enjoying for over a decade! I was excited to get this unit installed and while it was a bit harder than the other brands I've installed due to needing an electrical box that was no big deal to install.After installation we ran an empty load just to remove any residue that might be in the basin before loading any dishes. This is where I first noticed that this unit was loud! It may say 50 Decibels on the unit but on my phone, it was registering 65 Decibels about 5 feet away. We have an open floor plan so you could hear this all through the downstairs. My first thought was maybe this is due to the dishwasher being empty as having the jets hit plates, bowls and other objects might lower the noise. Unfortunately, it did not and this is the main reason why we have decided to return the dishwasher. The second reason is that a lot of features are locked behind an app you need to download on your phone. While I don't mind using apps myself, it seems strange to require everyone in our household of 4 to download an app just to know when a wash cycle is complete, especially since the exterior indicator lights don't stay on to show the dishwasher is clean. I know I would add plates myself and probably run it again. The app does offer a quiet mode option, but I question why basic features are locked behind an app that requires registration. Why would I need to monitor a dishwasher while away from my house? This seems like unnecessary technology, and while some consumers might appreciate it, it's just another thing I'd need to convince my family to install, or we'd need a shared tablet for everyone to use.I gave this two stars as it did a decent job of cleaning and is really good at holding a massive amount of plates. It lacks room for bowls compared to other dishwashers I have had in the past and the silverware caddy is a bit small.

Comments (English): This review was written about a product provided for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. **This is a review based on actual use.** As a two-person household, the amount of dishes isn't huge, but they pile up even after washing just three times a day, so I hesitated before installing this because it was such a hassle. But it is seriously super, super good! The design is clean and modern, so it matches my kitchen interior well, and best of all, I really love that it doesn't require a water supply installation. There is a lid on top, so you just need to pour a single load of water into it. If you prefer a water supply installation, you can connect it using the included hose. I was worried about the DIY installation, but it wasn't as difficult as I thought, and the instructions were helpful, so I finished it quickly. It is a bit heavy, so adult women might need to use some strength. And I am truly satisfied with its functionality as well. Thumbs up! Thanks to the powerful water jets, even greasy dishes and frying pans are washed cleanly, and I liked that there are various washing courses so I could choose the one that suits the situation. I intentionally tried washing without pre-washing, and it came out perfectly clean! The automatic door opening feature allows moisture to naturally escape after washing, so I also reduced my worries about water stains. The hot air drying function was especially useful. It dries much more cleanly than just drying clothes, so there are hardly any water stains left. Since it has a window-style design, you can see the dishes spinning inside, which was actually kind of fun to watch. Considering the features and the 2-year warranty, I think it offers really great value for money. I hesitated a bit at first, but after using it, I really feel like my quality of life has improved. I am extremely satisfied because it reduces dishwashing stress and saves time. It is the perfect entry-level dishwasher for households of 1 to 3 people! : *:* *:*:.
